cards.name: The Fool
cards.meaning_upright: A fresh start, being open to change, and trusting the process.
cards.meaning_reversed: Being careless, acting without thinking, or fear of starting.
cards.description: Moving into something new with an open mind and curiosity.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.meaning_upright: You have the ability and tools to reach your goals. It is a time to take action.
cards.meaning_reversed: You are not focused. You may be using your skills in a negative way or not using your talents at all.
cards.description: Using your tools and focus to make changes happen.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.meaning_upright: Trust your feelings, look for deep understanding, and notice things that are hidden.
cards.meaning_reversed: Ignoring your feelings, feeling confused, or keeping secrets for too long.
cards.description: A calm reminder to look beyond what you see on the outside.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.meaning_upright: Taking care of things, being creative, and having plenty.
cards.meaning_reversed: Difficulty creating, lack of care, or depending too much on others.
cards.description: Love, beauty, and the ability to help things grow.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.meaning_upright: Good organization, leadership, and a strong foundation.
cards.meaning_reversed: Being too strict, problems with control, or weak leadership.
cards.description: Creating order and safety by setting clear rules.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.meaning_upright: Following traditions, learning from a teacher, and shared values.
cards.meaning_reversed: Ignoring traditions, personal freedom, and questioning rules.
cards.description: Learning through established systems and groups.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.meaning_upright: A strong partnership, an important choice, and agreement between people.
cards.meaning_reversed: Disagreement, poor choices, or fear of a serious relationship.
cards.description: Making choices that match your personal beliefs.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.meaning_upright: Strong focus, steady movement, and achieving goals.
cards.meaning_reversed: Feeling lost, lack of control, or feeling tired from working too hard.
cards.description: Managing different forces to move ahead successfully.

cards.name: Strength
cards.meaning_upright: You have courage, patience, and quiet inner strength.
cards.meaning_reversed: You feel doubt, you are impatient, or you are trying too hard to force a result.
cards.description: Managing fear through kindness and being calm.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.meaning_upright: Time alone, understanding, and looking for answers inside yourself.
cards.meaning_reversed: Feeling lonely, avoiding people, or refusing help from others.
cards.description: Taking time away from others to think clearly.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.meaning_upright: A turning point, new cycles, and changes in luck.
cards.meaning_reversed: Fighting against change, delays, or repeating the same mistakes.
cards.description: Life is always moving. Be flexible and ready for what happens next.

cards.name: Justice
cards.meaning_upright: Truth, fairness, and making good choices.
cards.meaning_reversed: Unfairness, refusing to accept the truth, or avoiding results.
cards.description: Seeing facts clearly and acting in an honest way.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.meaning_upright: Take a break, stop trying to control things, and look at the situation in a new way.
cards.meaning_reversed: Waiting too long, being unwilling to change, or fear of moving forward.
cards.description: The ability to see things from a different point of view.

cards.name: Death
cards.meaning_upright: A situation is ending to allow for new growth.
cards.meaning_reversed: Holding on to the past or fear of change.
cards.description: Finish what is complete and prepare for something new.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.meaning_upright: Balance, healing, and combining things in the right way.
cards.meaning_reversed: Too much of something, being out of balance, or a lack of harmony.
cards.description: Mix different things to create a calm and steady result.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.meaning_upright: Feeling trapped by habits or material desires. You may feel unable to change your situation.
cards.meaning_reversed: Breaking free from bad patterns. Taking back control of your life.
cards.description: Look at what holds you back so you can let it go.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.meaning_upright: A sudden change that reveals the truth and removes things that are not solid.
cards.meaning_reversed: Trying to stop a necessary change, ongoing problems, or fear of the future.
cards.description: The truth is revealed. Build your life on what is real.

cards.name: The Star
cards.meaning_upright: You have hope for the future. Things are getting better.
cards.meaning_reversed: You feel discouraged or have many doubts. It is hard to stay positive.
cards.description: A sign that good things are coming.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.meaning_upright: Things are not clear. Trust your feelings and move slowly.
cards.meaning_reversed: Truth is becoming clear. You feel less afraid.
cards.description: It is hard to see the truth. Follow your inner guidance.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.meaning_upright: Happiness, energy, and feeling successful.
cards.meaning_reversed: Small problems, feeling sad, or a lack of confidence.
cards.description: Warmth, being seen, and clear truth.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.meaning_upright: A new understanding, looking at your past, and listening to your inner purpose.
cards.meaning_reversed: Doubting yourself, being too hard on yourself, or avoiding a choice.
cards.description: Choose your next step with honesty.

cards.name: The World
cards.meaning_upright: You have finished a task. You feel complete and successful.
cards.meaning_reversed: You have unfinished work. You are waiting for a final result.
cards.description: You have reached your goal. A new part of your life is starting.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: A new idea or a strong desire to start something.
cards.meaning_reversed: Delays, low energy, or a lack of interest.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: Making plans for the future and thinking about new goals.
cards.meaning_reversed: Fear of the future or staying in your comfort zone.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: Growth is happening. You are making progress. You are starting to see results.
cards.meaning_reversed: Things are delayed. There are problems. You are not finishing what you started.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: A happy event, feeling safe at home, and reaching a goal.
cards.meaning_reversed: Problems at home or an event that does not feel right.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: There is competition. People have different opinions. You learn by facing challenges.
cards.meaning_reversed: Avoiding a fight. You are stepping away from arguments that do not help you.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: You are winning or achieving your goals. People notice your hard work.
cards.meaning_reversed: You feel low confidence. You do not feel appreciated for your work.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: You are holding your position and defending your ideas.
cards.meaning_reversed: You are quitting too early or feeling unable to handle the pressure.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: Things are moving very fast. You will see quick progress.
cards.meaning_reversed: Things are slowing down. There may be confusion or a lack of focus.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: You are tired, but you keep going. You stay strong through hard times.
cards.meaning_reversed: You are exhausted. You are too worried about others. You do not ask for help.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: You have many responsibilities and are carrying too much.
cards.meaning_reversed: You need to share tasks, let go of work, or you are tired from too much stress.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: You are interested in new things. You are exploring ideas. You may receive exciting news.
cards.meaning_reversed: You act without thinking. You face delays. You do not have a clear plan.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: Taking quick action, seeking adventure, and moving forward.
cards.meaning_reversed: Being reckless, acting too fast, or changing your mind often.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: You are confident, kind, and a good leader.
cards.meaning_reversed: You feel insecure, jealous, or want too much attention.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: A leader with a clear plan and great skill.
cards.meaning_reversed: Acting without thinking, pride, or being too controlling.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: A new start in your feelings. A time for love and kindness.
cards.meaning_reversed: Hard to share feelings. Trouble giving or receiving love.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: A strong connection between two people. Working well together.
cards.meaning_reversed: Problems in a relationship. A lack of balance or poor communication.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: A time for friendship, happy events, and helping each other.
cards.meaning_reversed: Spending too much time on parties or having problems with friends.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: You feel bored or unhappy. You are thinking about your life and your choices.
cards.meaning_reversed: You feel interested again. You are ready to accept a new opportunity.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: You are feeling sad about a loss. You are focusing on your mistakes.
cards.meaning_reversed: You are starting to heal. You are looking at the good things you still have.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: Thinking about the past with happiness. Acts of kindness and simple joy.
cards.meaning_reversed: Focusing too much on the past. Trouble moving forward.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: You have many choices. It is hard to know what is real and what to focus on.
cards.meaning_reversed: You are gaining clarity. You can now make a clear decision and focus.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: Leaving a situation to look for something more meaningful.
cards.meaning_reversed: Being afraid to change or returning to something old.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: You are happy and satisfied. Your goals are achieved.
cards.meaning_reversed: You have too much of a good thing. You are not happy despite having what you wanted.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: Peace, happiness, and satisfaction in your life.
cards.meaning_reversed: Problems at home or expecting too much.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: You receive a kind message. You are curious about your feelings.
cards.meaning_reversed: You act without thinking about your feelings. You feel confused.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: A new romantic opportunity, an invitation, or listening to your feelings.
cards.meaning_reversed: Being moody, feeling disappointed, or having unrealistic expectations.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: You understand the feelings of others. You are kind and calm.
cards.meaning_reversed: You feel too much stress. You need better personal boundaries.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: A person who is calm, kind, and in control of their emotions.
cards.meaning_reversed: Using emotions to control others or hiding your true feelings.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: Clear thinking, finding the truth, and a new idea.
cards.meaning_reversed: Confusion, not having the right facts, or difficulty thinking clearly.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: A situation where no progress is made. You must make a difficult decision. You are protecting your feelings.
cards.meaning_reversed: You stop being undecided. The truth becomes clear. You feel overwhelmed by too much information.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: Feeling sad or hurt. Learning a difficult truth.
cards.meaning_reversed: Healing from pain. Choosing to forgive. Moving forward.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: It is time to rest and recover. Take a break to heal.
cards.meaning_reversed: You are not resting enough. You are returning to work too quickly.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: There is a disagreement. You may win, but it hurts your relationships.
cards.meaning_reversed: You choose to stop fighting. You decide to move on from a difficult situation.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: Moving away from a difficult situation toward a better future.
cards.meaning_reversed: Trouble letting go of the past or moving forward.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: You are using a plan to reach a goal. You may be keeping your actions private.
cards.meaning_reversed: You are telling the truth, being found out, or changing your plans.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: You feel stuck because of fear or your own negative thoughts.
cards.meaning_reversed: You are becoming free, seeing things clearly, and moving forward.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: You feel nervous and worried. You may have trouble sleeping.
cards.meaning_reversed: You find relief. You receive help or face your fears.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: A final ending, a difficult truth, and moving on.
cards.meaning_reversed: Recovery, getting stronger, and a new start.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: You are curious, looking for the truth, and paying attention to your surroundings.
cards.meaning_reversed: You are sharing rumors, acting too quickly, or making decisions without enough information.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: Taking quick action, moving fast, and thinking clearly.
cards.meaning_reversed: Acting without thinking, being unkind, or moving too fast.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: Using good judgment, being independent, and setting clear personal limits.
cards.meaning_reversed: Being unfriendly, feeling bitter, or using unkind words.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: You use logic, keep authority, and tell the truth.
cards.meaning_reversed: You misuse power or make unfair, strict judgments.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: A real chance to start something successful.
cards.meaning_reversed: A missed chance or a weak plan.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: You are balancing your priorities and adjusting to changes.
cards.meaning_reversed: You have too many responsibilities or you are struggling to stay balanced.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Working well with others, practicing a skill, and learning through experience.
cards.meaning_reversed: Difficulty working in a group or poor quality of work.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: You want safety and control. You are holding on to your money or belongings.
cards.meaning_reversed: You need to let go. You are making choices because you are afraid of losing things.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: You are going through a difficult time. You may feel like you do not have enough money or support. It is a good time to ask others for help.
cards.meaning_reversed: Things are starting to get better. You are finding the help you need. Your situation is improving.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: You give and receive help in a fair and kind way.
cards.meaning_reversed: The exchange is not fair, or there are hidden conditions.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Be patient. You are working toward a long-term goal. It is a good time to check your progress.
cards.meaning_reversed: You feel impatient. You are worried that your hard work is not producing results fast enough.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Practicing a skill and working hard to get better at it.
cards.meaning_reversed: Doing work poorly or feeling bored with daily tasks.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: You are independent, comfortable, and you value yourself.
cards.meaning_reversed: You rely too much on others or feel insecure, even after success.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: A strong family, lasting success, and financial security.
cards.meaning_reversed: Problems with money, family arguments, or a lack of stability.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: You are learning something new, starting a new project, or making a careful plan.
cards.meaning_reversed: You are delaying your work or not finishing what you started.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Moving forward slowly and doing your work well.
cards.meaning_reversed: Making no progress or refusing to change your habits.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Being helpful, creating comfort, and taking care of daily needs.
cards.meaning_reversed: Problems balancing work and home, or not taking care of yourself.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: You have success, financial security, and the ability to support others.
cards.meaning_reversed: Focusing too much on money or using wealth to control people.
